title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Mauban Bridge in Mauban, Tayabas to "Manuel L. Quezon Bridge.

text.en:
The Mauban Bridge in the municipality of Mauban, Province of Tayabas, shall hereafter be
known as "Manuel L. Quezon Bridge."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 2, 1935.
